##### Project general facts

The Bay Residence 2 is a haven of beauty situated at the water's edge along a stunning marina, offering premium apartments, penthouses, and podium townhouses with world-class design. This idyllic community brings together striking architecture with beautiful landscapes of crystal-clear waters, creating an ultra-modern quality of life that feels like a permanent holiday. Inspired architecture and superb craftsmanship have unified to create buildings that allow unobstructed views from spacious balconies and full-height windows, where residents can truly experience elevated living.

The development offers an exceptional array of amenities designed to complement a lifestyle of vibrant living with refined luxury, carefully crafted to embody the feeling of relaxation. Residents can enjoy spacious rooms with striking views and a waterfront lifestyle that brings a carefree existence and sense of peace. The community's combination of exclusivity and connectivity brings a true sense of belonging, setting new standards of luxury living.

Each residence features high-end finishes with low VOC paint, highly efficient glazing and insulation, and sustainable materials that deliver an elevated living statement. The thoughtfully designed interiors incorporate smart home technology and equipped kitchens with low-flow fixtures, ensuring both luxury and environmental responsibility. Every detail has been carefully considered to create a sophisticated and comfortable home environment that embraces modern sustainability practices.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated on Yas Island, a scenic island surrounded by crystal-clear waters and dotted with some of Abu Dhabi's most iconic landmarks, offering unforgettable experiences that enliven all the senses. The area combines an unsurpassed quality of life with an innovative business environment, making it one of the most desirable places in the world to live and work. The city is known for its modern skyscrapers, traditional culture, and amazingly diverse population from all different nationalities.

The waterfront development offers a spectacular boardwalk with restaurants and sparkling views of the Arabian Gulf, along with a vibrant pier opposite a five-star hotel. The area is home to a state-of-the-art event space and a series of exceptional dining experiences featuring renowned international concepts. Residents can enjoy a vibrant culinary scene with diverse options ranging from lounge bars to fine dining establishments.

The neighborhood boasts golden sands, turquoise seas, and a dynamic waterfront lifestyle that appeals to both residents and visitors alike. The area's world-class entertainment, dining, and leisure options create a truly immersive living experience. This distinguished location represents the perfect combination of island tranquility, urban convenience, and unparalleled lifestyle amenities, offering an unmatched living experience in one of Abu Dhabi's most iconic destinations.
